custom_logic_notes: NRTR (Nick Rypock Trail Reverse) calculates dynamic support/resistance levels based on ATR. When price crosses above the NRTR up-level, a long is entered; when price crosses below the NRTR down-level, a short is entered. The existing position is closed on opposite signal before opening the new one. The NRTR level acts as both entry trigger and trailing stop. SL/TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 for 5-digit broker compatibility.
python_conversion_notes: NRTR indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python since it is a custom indicator derived from ATR. The NRTR state machine (tracking trend direction and level adjustments) must be ported carefully as it uses recursive state from previous bars. ATR can use ta-lib or pandas_ta. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled in SL/TP calculation. New bar detection using bar time comparison is needed.
